revision_rule: Not revised after the pilot begins. Deviations during execution are logged as data, never repaired here.
construction: Arm k (0-indexed, in the order BASE, DOC, PRO, DAF, BOTH) translates batch B((k+c-1) mod 10)+1 in cycle c (c=1..10): each arm starts at its own batch and proceeds cyclically.

fresh_attention_rotation.rule: The arm receiving the researcher's first working session of each cycle rotates in the order BASE, DOC, PRO, DAF, BOTH, repeat.

micro_replication: 3 units per arm, per-arm seeded streams; already drawn in tools/examples/EXAMPLE_micro_replication_seed-20261113.csv; translated at the end in the same session order, not now.
